details:
Q1: Which area of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) The review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml` and its `scripts/review_*` helpers)
B) The orchestrator poller and project flow (`orchestrate_poll.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
C) The clarify/plan/implement phase workflows and their prompts
D) Documentation only (README, docs/)
E) None of these: describe the specific component and problem in a reply (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What kind of improvement is wanted?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure you have seen; give the run link, issue or PR number, or error text (RECOMMENDED)
B) Lower runtime or cost (GitHub API calls, model tokens, CI minutes); name the workflow or job
C) Make it more reliable (fewer stalls, retries or human escalations); name the symptom
D) A new feature or behaviour; describe the expected behaviour
E) Clearer docs or logs only
Q3: What would show that this issue is done?
Choices:
A) A concrete, testable result you state in your reply (for example "run X no longer fails with Y") (RECOMMENDED)
B) A measurable target on a named metric (for example "job Z finishes under N minutes")
C) No fixed target: close the issue, because it cannot be implemented as written
